## Mova 1.9.2

Mova 1.9.2 让文件改名、移动和删除之后的体验不再依赖一次整库扫描。

打开电影或单集时，Mova 会先核对它的本地文件是否还在磁盘上。全部版本都不在时，详情页显示"资源已不存在，正在重新扫描"，而不是进入详情后播放失败；只少了部分版本时照常打开，默认播放仍在的版本，缺失的版本在版本选择里标出。核对只看不删：缺失的文件交给一次只针对该条目所在目录的扫描，由扫描决定是删除整个条目、新增条目还是只少了几集，结果仍通过扫描事件到达，前端不会自行删除条目。这种范围扫描不遍历、不对账范围外的任何目录，也不替换媒体库的存储记录；同一目录十分钟内只自动触发一次，已有待执行的扫描会合并目录，正在运行的扫描直接复用。

单集的文件没了不再把这一集连同记录一起删掉：只要剧集还有任何一个文件，这一集就留在剧集里标记"资源不存在"，播放进度、已看状态和继续观看入口都保留；文件放回来或改回原名后，按季集号重新挂回同一集。整部剧集的文件都没了才连同记录删除。

同名不同年份的电影不再合并：`Dune (1984)/Dune.mkv` 和 `Dune (2021)/Dune.mkv` 这样只有目录带年份的文件，会采用同名目录的年份，成为两部电影。改名或移动的文件按大小和修改时间识别：旧路径照常删除，播放进度迁移到新路径解析出的条目，但只在它仍是同一部作品时（同一个 TMDB 绑定，或任一方未绑定）；改成另一部作品的名字时，旧条目连同记录一起删除。

接口新增内容均为向后兼容：`GET /api/media-items/{id}` 增加 `source_status`、`missing_media_file_ids` 和 `rescan_scan_job_id`，`ScanJobResponse` 增加 `scope_paths`，剧集大纲中文件缺失的本地集 `is_available` 为 `false` 且仍带 `media_item_id`。包含迁移 0009（`media_files.file_modified_at_ms`）和 0010（`scan_jobs.scope_paths`），均为新增可空列，原地升级，不需要重扫或重建缓存；改名识别从本版本第一次扫描记录修改时间之后开始生效，旧版本合并在一起的同名电影会在下一次扫描时分开。

---

## Mova 1.9.2

Mova 1.9.2 stops a renamed, moved or deleted file from waiting for a whole-library scan.

Opening a movie or an episode first verifies that its local files are still on disk. When every version is gone the page shows "resource no longer exists, rescanning" instead of a detail page whose playback then fails; when only some versions are gone the page opens as usual, defaults to a version that is present and marks the missing ones. The check only looks, it never deletes: the missing files are handed to a scan limited to the directories that held them, and that scan decides whether the item is removed, a new item appears or only some episodes are gone. The outcome arrives through the usual scan events; the web never removes an item on its own. Such a scoped scan traverses and reconciles nothing outside its directories and leaves the library's storage record alone. A directory is handed over at most once per ten minutes, a pending scan absorbs further directories and a running scan is reused.

An episode whose file is gone is no longer deleted together with its records. While the series still has any file, the episode stays in it marked unavailable, with its playback progress, watched state and the continue-watching entry; a file that comes back, or is renamed back, reattaches to the same episode by season and episode number. Only when no file of the series is left is it removed with its records.

Films sharing a title but not a year no longer merge: `Dune (1984)/Dune.mkv` and `Dune (2021)/Dune.mkv`, where only the folder carries the year, adopt the year of the folder naming the same title and become two films. A renamed or moved file is recognised by size and modification time: the old path is removed as before and the playback progress moves to the item the new path resolves to, but only while that is the same work (the same TMDB binding, or either side unbound). A file relabelled as another title loses its old entry together with its records.

All API additions are backward compatible: `GET /api/media-items/{id}` gains `source_status`, `missing_media_file_ids` and `rescan_scan_job_id`, `ScanJobResponse` gains `scope_paths`, and a local episode without files appears in the episode outline with `is_available` set to `false` and its `media_item_id` kept. The release contains migrations 0009 (`media_files.file_modified_at_ms`) and 0010 (`scan_jobs.scope_paths`), both additive nullable columns that upgrade in place; no rescan or cache rebuild is required. Rename detection starts once a scan on this version has recorded modification times, and same-title films an earlier version merged split on the next scan.
